root_idea.summary: The lexical evidence centers on هَيْئَةٌ, the form or state in which something is found, and on putting something into a suitable or ready condition.
root_idea.development: The preparation and facilitation senses develop from furnishing or arranging something into a fitting state. The intransitive Form V denotes becoming prepared, feasible, or attainable. A separate etymological note treats هَيَا as a vocative form equivalent to يَا, rather than establishing an independent root-wide semantic principle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized singular nominal citation form.

senses.definition: To prepare, provide, arrange, or put into a suitable state; hence, to make an affair feasible or facilitate it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quranic uses, the verb concerns preparing or making available what is sought, including guidance or facility in an affair.
In the supplied Quranic constructions, especially كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ, the noun denotes likeness in form or shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become of good or goodly form, appearance, or qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: هَيُؤَ is reported as synonymous; one analysis gives the latter an intensive or wonder-like force, such as “how excellent is he in form or appearance.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire, long for, or long to see someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَيْهِ for the object desired or longed for.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invest someone with a form, guise, garb, or external state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the form-giving or clothing specialization of the transitive Form II verb, distinct from its Quranic preparation and facilitation use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become prepared, ready, disposed, or arranged; of an affair or thing, to become feasible, practicable, attainable, or within reach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With لِ, it can mean to prepare oneself for something or to be ready or about to perform an action. A reported Quranic reading uses the verb for preparing oneself for another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree together upon a matter or course of action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persons reaching agreement concerning what is to be done.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A call summoning to food or drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A camel-specific usage is also reported, meaning a call to camels to feed or drink; the evidence varies between feeding and drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expression of regret for something that has passed away or escaped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the exclamatory expression يَا هَىْءَ مَا لِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expression of wonder or astonishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an alternative interpretation of the same exclamatory expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imperative verbal noun meaning “pay attention,” “take heed,” or “attend.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be preceded by يَا, with the final vowel used for ease of pronunciation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guise, garb, external state, condition, quality, or manner of being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The broader Classical range includes state with respect to apparel and the idiomatic description of people distinguished by good qualities and a consistent way or manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In logic, an accidental mode or contingent attribute.
A person of good or goodly form, appearance, or qualities associated with هَيْئَةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing the person’s form or other properties.
A passive participial adjective derived from هَيَّأَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A matter or arrangement that people agree together to undertake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The arrangement may be one reached by mutual estimation or agreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female camel that seldom fails to become pregnant after being covered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use concerning reproductive reliability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expression of warning or avoidance, equivalent to “beware” or “avoid.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in the construction هَيَّاكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ كَذَا, meaning “beware of doing such-and-such.”
